text: {"established":["The contract asks for a straight-line bitvector program matching released examples, returned as opcode/constant pairs in values, with order and files empty. Width is 6; constants are 0–63; execute pairs left to right; maximum 7 instructions; any matching program within that limit is accepted.","Released examples (x→y): 58→9, 61→37, 19→15, 53→5, 6→27, 47→29, 57→20, 22→26, 60→32, 0→19, 62→25, 56→17, 59→12, 54→56, 32→49, 25→55, 31→63, 20→35, 45→36, 43→13, 26→42.","The public feedback reports that candidate values [0,15] violate example record-0001 (61→37); no replacement answer was supplied. Under the contract, opcode 0 adds its constant modulo 64, so this candidate gives 12 for x=61, not 37."],"retained_observations":["Operation definitions: 0 adds c modulo 2^width; 1 XORs c; 2 multiplies by c modulo 2^width; 3 rotates left by c modulo the width.","The candidate was described as a best simple candidate from released examples, but its reported failure rules out that candidate for the released examples, not a broader method or family of programs."],"uncertainties":["No replacement answer or other candidate results are provided; the examples and feedback do not establish which program, if any, will match all requirements."]}
